record.text: Our CE MDR technical file was submitted eight months ago and the notified body has come back with 23 queries about our software lifecycle documentation under IEC 62304; we do not have in-house regulatory affairs staff experienced with the new MDR annexes and hiring one is taking longer than expected.
record.detail: We submitted our CE marking technical file under MDR in July last year. The notified body, Zertivo GmbH, came back four months later with 23 written queries. About 18 of the 23 concern our software lifecycle documentation under IEC 62304, specifically the traceability between our risk management records under ISO 14971 and the software safety classification rationale, and the completeness of our verification and validation activity records. We built our QMS years ago under the old MDD and have been adapting it incrementally, but the MDR annexes — particularly Annex I and the software-specific parts of Annex II — are much more demanding. We have two quality engineers on staff who are competent at our manufacturing QMS but have not worked through an MDR submission before at this level of detail. We posted a regulatory affairs manager role three months ago and have not found the right candidate. We need practical help drafting responses to these 23 queries and updating the underlying documentation. The notified body has given us a six-month window to respond before the file lapses. Missing that window means restarting the submission, which would cost us at minimum one full year and delay entry into two new national markets.
